title: Troubleshooting TRAINEX
summary: Practical checks for missing 3D assets, inert controls, inconsistent indications and deployment errors.
prerequisites: Access to the browser developer tools and project source

steps.title: 3D cabin does not load
steps.body: Confirm apps/web/public/models/cabin/trainex_cabin.glb exists and the browser can request /models/cabin/trainex_cabin.glb.

steps.title: In-cab button is not clickable
steps.body: Check the imported mesh names and input-manager mappings; ensure the session is RUNNING and the control is visibly exposed for raycasting.

steps.title: Gauge or panel stays blank
steps.body: Check names such as SPEED_Dial, BC_Dial, BP_Dial and TCMS_ScreenGraphic, and confirm each display surface has suitable UV coordinates.

steps.title: Door lamp looks incorrect
steps.body: Read the authoritative doorState and allDoorsClosed fields; OPENING or CLOSING is not confirmed CLOSED.

steps.title: Build fails in Vercel
steps.body: Confirm the Vite Root Directory is apps/web, outside-root workspace source access is enabled, and the root npm lockfile includes required workspaces.

steps.title: Pairing fails
steps.body: Check relay availability, secure WebSocket URL, pairing ID, and session status.

notes: Do not change artist geometry to compensate for a missing code mapping.
A simulated pressure reading requires a modeled pressure state; avoid treating a fabricated value as measured train pressure.
